entries.name: Chart
entries.summary: Data with character. Customizable curves, areas and tactile bars.

entries.name: Breadcrumb
entries.summary: A clear path back. Tactile links and a distinct current location.

entries.name: Separator
entries.summary: A quiet break. Horizontal and vertical rules between related spaces.

entries.name: Raised button
entries.summary: A satisfying press. Six variants, three sizes, and clear action feedback.

entries.name: Reaction Button
entries.summary: Likes, favorites and reactions with a little personality.

entries.name: Input
entries.summary: A considered starting point for every form.

entries.name: Field
entries.summary: Labels, help and validation that belong together.

entries.name: Input Group
entries.summary: Inputs, icons and actions on one continuous surface.

entries.name: Textarea
entries.summary: Room for longer thoughts, with resize and character counts.

entries.name: Number Field
entries.summary: Precise numbers with tactile step controls.

entries.name: OTP Field
entries.summary: Verification codes with keyboard and paste support.

entries.name: Checkbox
entries.summary: One choice or a whole group. Every state feels right.

entries.name: Radio Group
entries.summary: One considered choice, from a list to a grid of cards.

entries.name: Switch
entries.summary: Small movements. Clear decisions.

entries.name: Select
entries.summary: A familiar choice with grouped options and tactile feedback.

entries.name: Autocomplete
entries.summary: Find the next choice as you type.

entries.name: Tabs
entries.summary: Move between views with a springy, measured indicator.

entries.name: Dropdown Menu
entries.summary: Commands, choices and nested paths, close at hand.

entries.name: Stepper
entries.summary: A clear path from the first step to the last.

entries.name: Accordion
entries.summary: Let the details unfold at their own pace.

entries.name: Card
entries.summary: Composable surfaces with unmistakable depth.

entries.name: Bento Grid
entries.summary: A little structure for your next big idea.

entries.name: Cards Carousel
entries.summary: A tactile collection of stories to explore.

entries.name: Testimonials
entries.summary: Give good words a considered place.

entries.name: Badge
entries.summary: Compact context, considered colors and visible contours.

entries.name: Dialog
entries.summary: Make space for a focused decision.

entries.name: Toast
entries.summary: Timely confirmations, useful actions and honest outcomes.

entries.name: Progress
entries.summary: Measured movement, from the first byte to done.

entries.name: Achievement
entries.summary: Make progress worth keeping.

entries.name: Kinetic Type
entries.summary: Typography with an entrance worth watching.

entries.name: Shuffle Deck
entries.summary: A deck of perspectives, ready for a shuffle.

entries.name: Text Loop
entries.summary: Words with a rhythm, on sculpted ribbons.

entries.name: Avatar
entries.summary: Familiar faces in tactile frames.

entries.name: Map
entries.summary: Neutral cartography with useful, tactile controls.

entries.name: Tooltip
entries.summary: Context at the right moment. Focus, hover, timing and collision-aware hints.

entries.name: Popover
entries.summary: A little more room, right next to the action. Non-modal by design.

entries.name: Slider
entries.summary: One value or a considered range. Continuous control with tactile handles.

entries.name: Calendar
entries.summary: A day to remember. Standalone single-date and range selection.

entries.name: Date Picker
entries.summary: Make a date. A field, a popover and a calendar working together.

entries.name: Table
entries.summary: The work, at a glance. Semantic tables and useful data interactions.

entries.name: Pagination
entries.summary: One page at a time. A clear path through larger collections.

entries.name: Sheet
entries.summary: Bring the details in. A focused panel from any side of the screen.

entries.name: File Upload
entries.summary: A place for your files. Drop, preview, retry and keep moving.

entries.name: Skeleton
entries.summary: Keep the shape of what comes next. Quiet structural loading states.

entries.name: Alert
entries.summary: A message that stays. Clear context, useful actions and considered tones.

entries.name: Folder
entries.summary: A tabbed folder that unfolds into selectable documents.

# Third-party component foundations

## Codex product icon

`public/codex-icon.png` is the unmodified `codex-app-ga-logo-3e5209898ca3.png` asset supplied in OpenAI's official Codex VS Code extension (`openai.chatgpt`, version 26.901.22334). It identifies the compatible OpenAI product in the Duoop UI MCP announcement. Codex and its icon belong to OpenAI; this brand asset is not covered by Duoop UI's Apache-2.0 license. The MCP is maintained by Duoop UI and does not imply OpenAI endorsement. Official extension: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=openai.chatgpt

## MCP dependencies

The standalone MCP uses the official Model Context Protocol TypeScript SDK and Zod, installed from npm. Their MIT licenses and transitive notices remain in their respective package distributions.

Duoop adapts the official composition examples and uses the unstyled runtime packages below. Duoop CSS, demos and integration are maintained in this repository. Dependency source is installed through npm, rather than vendored.

- Radix Primitives — Tooltip, Popover, Slider and Dialog (Sheet): https://github.com/radix-ui/primitives and https://www.radix-ui.com/primitives/docs/components
- React DayPicker v9 — Calendar and Date Picker: https://github.com/gpbl/react-day-picker and https://daypicker.dev/v9
- React Dropzone — file selection and validation: https://github.com/react-dropzone/react-dropzone

The following MIT notices are retained for these foundations and accompanying examples. Other transitive dependencies retain their own notices in their npm distributions.

/** A single vector drawing: curved bowl, inset handles and connected laurel branches. */
export function AchievementIllustration({ concealed = false }) {
  const leaves = (
    <g strokeWidth="1.5">
      <path d="M59 125C39 111 27 90 29 64" fill="none" />
      <path d="M29 76C20 73 18 63 22 55c8 5 11 13 7 21Z" />
      <path d="M30 85c-10-1-17-8-18-17 11 1 17 7 18 17Z" />
      <path d="M34 95c-1-10 3-18 11-22 3 10-1 18-11 22Z" />
      <path d="M40 106c-12 0-20-5-24-14 12-1 20 4 24 14Z" />
      <path d="M48 115c-4-9-2-19 5-25 5 10 3 18-5 25Z" />
      <path d="M58 124c-12 2-22-1-28-9 12-4 21 0 28 9Z" />
    </g>
  );
  return (
    <svg
      className="achievement-trophy-art"
      viewBox="0 0 200 160"
      fill="none"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <g className="achievement-ribbon">
        {leaves}
        <g transform="translate(200 0) scale(-1 1)">{leaves}</g>
      </g>
      <g strokeWidth="2">
